svg.title: SPE Mines PetroBowl team polo, design 02

g.text: COLORADO SCHOOL OF MINES · SPE STUDENT CHAPTER
White Nike Dri-FIT polo · navy and metallic gold embroidery
Wearer's right chest, 3.5 in wide. Two trophies flank a
derrick in an oil drop. Navy and metallic gold thread.
Wearer's left chest, 3.25 in wide, full colour.
Comes embroidered on the left sleeve of this polo.
PETROBOWL with a small gold MINES line, 4 in wide.
Nike Dri-FIT Micro Pique 2.0 Polo (NKDC1963), White
Open hem sleeves · rolled-forward shoulder seams
